The case is set from the brief and the two demand files. Every value below came from the knowledge base's assumptions document for this hackathon case (knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md), not from your files — please confirm them, and give me the two values nothing states.

CONFIRM (source: knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md, "Case values" / "Requirements" sections):
1. time_zone of both demand series = UTC | the CSV dates carry no offset; gemini reads them as UTC unless a zone is named | assumption
2. demand.heating.return_temperature = 60 °C | design choice, the brief leaves it to the team (colder than the 100 °C supply)
3. demand.heating.return_pressure = 6 bar | team assumption
4. demand.cooling.return_temperature = 25 °C | design choice, the brief leaves it to the team (warmer than the 20 °C supply)
5. demand.cooling.return_pressure = 4 bar | team assumption
6. demand.cooling.dew_point_margin = 1 K | team assumption
7. demand.cooling.indoor_temperature = 26 °C | team assumption
8. demand.cooling.indoor_relative_humidity = 50 % | team assumption
9. site.air.temperature = 10 °C (constant) | team assumption
10. site.air.pressure = 101325 Pa (constant) | team assumption
11. site.fluid.sand_concentration = 20 mg/l | team assumption
12. utilities.electricity.co2_intensity = 300 g/kWh | organisers' reference value
13. utilities.gas.composition = CH4 0.8249507401227822, C2H6 0.039549858193534584, C3H8 0.012748086337494389, CO2 0.011912342910726407, N2 0.11083897243546233 (mole fractions, sum 1) | team assumption
14. heat_delivered: unmet share of the yearly heat demand ≤ 0.01 | the brief asks the demand be met but gives no tolerance; 1 % is the team's
15. cold_delivered: unmet share of the yearly cold demand ≤ 0.01 | same
16. volume_balance: reinjection ratio 0.99999 to 1.00001 while running | the brief requires equal production/injection volumes; the tolerance is the team's

STILL MISSING — please give me these two, with their units:
A. site.air.relative_humidity (a fraction 0 to 1, e.g. 0.8 — not a percentage) — the outside air's humidity; no file and no knowledge document states it, and it is needed for air coolers and chillers that reject heat to air.
B. utilities.gas.heating_value (J/kg or kJ/kg) — the heating value of the bought grid gas; the composition is known but no source states its heating value, and it is needed to price and burn the gas.

Options: approve all (the 16 above; A and B stay open), change some, or stop. You may also type the values for A and B, or any corrections.

Economics of the case, from the cost catalogue.
All values above are the case's own assumptions document (knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md), which covers this hackathon case key by key; the catalogue fills only the keys it does not give. The per-energy O&M map is left open because the case has cooling and the document gives no per-energy price; no subsidy is given, so the subsidy keys stay open.
